# langfuse_score_config (Resource)

Manage a score config (the schema that scores of a given name must follow) in a project using project-scoped credentials. The Langfuse API has no delete endpoint for score configs: destroying this resource archives the score config (is_archived = true) and removes it from state. Replacing the resource therefore leaves the previous score config behind as archived. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:score_config_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_score_config" "accuracy" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "accuracy"
  data_type          = "NUMERIC"
  description        = "How accurate the answer is, from 0 (wrong) to 1 (correct)."
  min_value          = 0
  max_value          = 1
}

resource "langfuse_score_config" "tone" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "tone"
  data_type          = "CATEGORICAL"
  categories = [
    { label = "formal", value = 0 },
    { label = "casual", value = 1 },
  ]
}

# BOOLEAN score configs get their True/False categories from Langfuse.
resource "langfuse_score_config" "hallucination" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "hallucination"
  data_type          = "BOOLEAN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_type` (String) Data type of the scores. Valid values: NUMERIC, BOOLEAN, CATEGORICAL, TEXT. Changing it forces a new score config.
- `name` (String) Name of the score config. Scores with this name are validated against it.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `categories` (Attributes List) Categories for CATEGORICAL scores. Required for CATEGORICAL and not allowed for other data types; BOOLEAN score configs get True/False categories from Langfuse automatically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `description` (String) Description shown to annotators.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the score config is archived. Archived score configs cannot be used for new scores. Defaults to false.
- `max_value` (Number) Maximum value for NUMERIC scores. Removing it forces a new score config.
- `min_value` (Number) Minimum value for NUMERIC scores. Removing it forces a new score config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the score config.

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Required:

- `label` (String) Label of the category.
- `value` (Number) Numeric value of the category.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_score_config.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${SCORE_CONFIG_ID}"
```
